This repository contains a single Next.js application in `/casa-cutuco-v10`; treat that directory as the project root for installs, builds, and code changes.

Before validating changes from the repository root, run `cd casa-cutuco-v10 && npm install`.

Validate application changes from the repository root with `cd casa-cutuco-v10 && npm run build`.

There are currently no dedicated `test` or `lint` scripts in `casa-cutuco-v10/package.json`, so do not spend time searching for them unless the repository adds them later.
